ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
en: (1) Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief][1958] until there came to them clear evidence –
enNotes: [1958]- i.e., from their erroneous beliefs and superstitions.
tr: Lam yakunil-ladhīna kafarū min ahlil-kitābi wal-mushrikīna munfakkīna ḥattā taʾtiyahumul-bayyinah

ar: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
en: (2) A Messenger from Allāh, reciting purified[1959] scriptures
(3) Within which are correct writings [i.e., rulings and laws].

ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
en: (4) Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided[1960] until after there had come to them clear evidence.
tr: Wamā tafarraqal-ladhīna ūtul-kitāba illā mim baʿdi mā jāʾathumul-bayyinah

ar: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
en: (5) And they were not commanded except to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakāh. And that is the correct religion.
tr: Wamā umirū illā liyaʿbudullāha mukhliṣīna lahud-dīna ḥunafāʾa wayuqīmuṣ-ṣalāta wayuʾtuz-zakāta wadhālika dīnul-qayyimah

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
en: (6) Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
tr: Innal-ladhīna kafarū min ahlil-kitābi wal-mushrikīna fī nāri jahannama khālidīna fīhā, ulāʾika hum sharrul-bariyyah

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
en: (7) Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
tr: Innal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti ulāʾika hum khayrul-bariyyah

ar: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
en: (8) Their reward with their Lord will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allāh being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
tr: Jazāʾuhum ʿinda rabbihim jannātu ʿadnin tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadā, raḍiyallāhu ʿanhum waraḍū ʿanh, dhālika liman khashiya rabbah
